The '''Denab system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Denab/Legends|Denab]].
